title: Kita Place in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin funds the place and leaves the search to you.** The Senate's own wording is that you go looking for a free place in a Kita of your choice and contact them yourself. The Kita-Gutschein is money, not a placement.

**Two dates on the voucher.** Apply to the Jugendamt of your own district at the **earliest nine months** and at the **latest two months** before you want care to start. A Teilzeit voucher for up to seven hours never expires, but a **Ganztags voucher dies after seven months** if you have not signed a contract.

**From the first birthday you have a claim to up to seven hours a day** with no needs test. More than seven hours has to be justified by work, training or family grounds. Levels: 4 to 5 hours Halbtags, over 5 to 7 Teilzeit, over 7 to 9 Ganztags, over 9 extended.

**The doors near you are not the places near you.** Berlin has **2,917 Kitas** and **200,869 licensed places**, but the median Kita holds **48** children. One in three is licensed for under 30 and that third holds only **10 per cent** of the places, while the **744** houses licensed for 100 or more hold **56 per cent**.

**Your legal catchment is wider than your real one.** When the Jugendamt runs a Platznachweis it may point at a neighbouring district, and a journey of **up to 30 minutes by public transport** counts as reasonable. Build the first call list inside a walk you will still do in February.

**It is free, with one line for lunch.** Attendance costs nothing. You pay a **Verpflegungsanteil of 23 euro a month** for the warm lunch, and breakfast is not funded. A Kita may **not** charge for reserving a place, admission, a deposit or cleaning, extra payments are voluntary and capped at **100 euro a month**, and being forced into a Förderverein is banned.

**Book the paediatrician early.** Measles protection is compulsory: two vaccinations from age two, one from age one. You also need a doctor's Unbedenklichkeitsbescheinigung and proof of vaccination counselling before care starts.
